title: Jerusalem Old City Complete Tour
description: Walk through the four quarters of the Old City, visit the Western Wall, Church of the Holy Sepulchre, and Temple Mount area. Includes hidden gems and local stories.

title: Mount of Olives & City of David
description: Explore ancient Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives panoramic viewpoint through the City of David archaeological site and Hezekiah's Tunnel.

title: Tel Aviv Street Art & Bauhaus Tour
description: Discover Tel Aviv's vibrant street art scene in Florentin, then explore the UNESCO White City Bauhaus architecture. Includes café stops.

title: Tel Aviv Food & Market Experience
description: Taste your way through Carmel Market, Levinsky spice market, and hidden local restaurants. Vegetarian options available.

title: Galilee Hiking & Waterfalls
description: Full-day hike through the lush Galilee region visiting hidden waterfalls, ancient ruins, and panoramic viewpoints over the Sea of Galilee.

title: Golan Heights & Druze Villages
description: Explore the Golan Heights with visits to Druze villages, local cuisine tasting, ancient Gamla fortress, and stunning viewpoints.

title: Dead Sea & Masada Sunrise
description: Early morning climb of Masada fortress at sunrise, followed by floating in the Dead Sea and Ein Gedi nature reserve visit.

title: Negev Desert & Ramon Crater
description: Adventure day in the Negev desert: Ramon Crater rim walk, desert wildlife spotting, Bedouin tea experience, and stargazing.

title: Jerusalem Holy Sites Deep Dive
description: In-depth exploration of Jerusalem's sacred sites for all three Abrahamic religions. Includes underground tunnels and rooftop views.

title: Safed Kabbalah & Mysticism Tour
description: Journey to the mystical city of Safed (Tzfat) in the north. Visit ancient synagogues, artist quarter, and learn about Jewish mysticism.
